षट्केतु: Ṣaṭketu — a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 87.
षट्पुर: Ṣaṭpuras — a Vindhya tribe. Br. II. 16. 65.
षट्प्रिय: Ṣaṭpriya — a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 87.
षट्ब्रह्माण: Ṣaṭbrahmāṇa — Marīci, Kratu, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, and Vasumat or Vasiṣṭha; these are known as Prajāpatis as they are concerned with the increase of santāna to the world. Vā. 65. 43-48.
षट्सुर: Ṣaṭsuras — on the other side of the Vindhyas. Vā. 45. 133.
षडङ्ग: Ṣaḍaṅga — the six limbs of the state including the king who must protect it with great care. M. 220. 21; Vā. 30. 293; 99. 39.
षडङ्गविद्: Ṣaḍaṅgavid — one versed in the six supplementary sciences of the Vedas, fit for śrāddha. Vi. III. 15. 2.
षडपाय: Ṣaḍapāyas — a king to be expert in. Br. IV. 21. 53.
षडानन: Ṣaḍānana (Skanda) — born out of the left side of the belly of Umā;1 born at Śaravaṇa in Kailāsa.2 1) Br. IV. 30. 101; M. 158. 48-49; 160. 23. 2) Vā. 41. 37.
षड्ज: Ṣaḍja — the sixteenth kalpa; the sages, called Ṣaḍjanas. Vā. 21. 34.
Ṣaḍja(grāma) — a particular scale (music);1 fourteen kinds of.2 1) Vā. 21. 37; 86. 39; 87. 28. 2) Ib. 86. 49; Vi. II. 14. 32.
षड्जन: Ṣaḍjanas — sages of the sixteenth kalpa; with these was born Maheśvara. Vā. 21. 34.
षड्दन्त: Ṣaḍdanta (I) — a commander of Bhaṇḍa. Br. IV. 21. 87.
षड्दर्शन: Ṣaḍdarśanas — Brāhmam, Śaivam, Vaiṣṇavam, Sauram, Śāktam and Ārhatam. Vā. 104. 16.
षण्ड: Ṣaṇḍa — the asura; also Śaṇḍa, brother of Marka; one of the disciples of Śukra. The Asuras were experts in the magic of warfare and hence Devas won them over by offer-ing a graha to them in the sacrifices; thus the Asuras were defeated. Br. III. 72. 72, 87; 73. 63-4; Vā. 97. 72 and 86; 98. 63; 108. 60.
षण्मुख: Ṣaṇmukha (I) — (Kumāra); anecdotes of, in the Skān-dapurāṇa;1 a leader in the battle of Tripuram;2 all the wives of the seven seers except Arundhatī served Kumāra as mothers. Hence the six-faced.3 1) Br. III. 10. 42; M. 53. 42. 2) Ib. 136. 68; 137. 32; 159. 3; 160. 11 and 28. 3) Vā. 72. 40.
Ṣaṇmukha (II) — a name of Vighneśvara. Br. IV. 44. 68.
षष्टमांशम्: Ṣaṣṭamāṃśam — one-sixth of their merit the Brahmans give to righteous kings. Bhā. V. 15. 11.
षष्टिमायापुरम्: Ṣaṣṭimāyāpuram — sacred to Lalitā pīṭha. Br. IV. 44. 98.
षाड्गुण्यविधि: Ṣāḍguṇyavidhi — the six-fold policy of kings. M. 215. 16.
षोडशपत्राब्ज: Ṣoḍaśapatrābja — here were sixteen śaktis beginning with Dinamiśrā; another group of 16 śaktis commencing with Kalā is also said to reside here; these were also attached to mahākāla. Br. IV. 32. 11; 14-16, 19.
षोडशास्र: Ṣoḍaśāsra — a temple in different shapes; with shining towers. M. 269. 29, 34, 39.
षोडशाहफलम्: Ṣoḍaśāhaphalam — by giving sarpi in the śrāddha. Vā. 79. 11.
षोडशि: Ṣoḍaśi (I) — born from the eastern face of Brahmā. Bhā. III. 12. 40.
Ṣoḍaśi (II) — the waxing and waning of the moon. Vā. 52. 70.
षोडशीक्षेत्रम्: Ṣoḍaśīkṣetram — of Lalitā; with nine hills and seven seas. Br. IV. 31. 10-19.
